title: WWE Championship match announced
raw_html:
WWE officially announced that Alex Champion will defend the WWE Championship against Jordan Star next Saturday in Chicago after their confrontation on Monday Night Raw. The company confirmed the match after a long interview in which Champion said that the challenger had earned this opportunity through several important victories.

Jordan Star replied that the title match would be the most important contest of a career that began twelve years ago. The wrestler promised to remain focused and preserve every detail of the preparation, while officials stated that more information about the event schedule would follow through official channels.
